notes: NEX1 Orchestrator + Minimal Workstation · founder-authorised Phase 7 · 2026-09-12. Connective tissue between existing NEX subsystems. NEVER a new intelligence layer. NEVER invents decisions.
constitutional_purpose_locked: The orchestrator sequences existing specialists into one deterministic, observable end-to-end execution path. It preserves the original user objective, enforces stage dependencies, refuses hidden transitions, and halts at the founder boundary. It does not build another brain.

terminal_state_semantics_locked_p_e.ORCHESTRATION_COMPLETED: state machine reached the end of its currently-implemented path · deliverable does NOT necessarily exist · reachable when EXECUTION/VERIFICATION/RELEASE were NOT_IMPLEMENTED
terminal_state_semantics_locked_p_e.DELIVERABLE_COMPLETED: real code was created · real tests ran · real release evidence gathered · every downstream stage was truly COMPLETE (not NOT_IMPLEMENTED)

p_e_rule_locked: NOT_IMPLEMENTED → COMPLETED is forbidden terminology. NEX MUST NEVER conflate 'workflow reached its end' with 'deliverable was produced'.
invariants: NO state skipping · NO hidden transitions · every transition records previous · next · reason · timestamp · actor · evidence_refs · authorisation_state
orchestrator MUST NEVER manufacture a successful stage · MUST NEVER convert UNKNOWN into PASS · MUST NEVER convert NOT_MEASURED into PASS · MUST NEVER convert REJECTED into FAILURE
orchestrator MUST preserve every specialist outcome state exactly
orchestrator MUST halt at FOUNDER_DECISION · founder actions AUTHORISE / REJECT / HOLD are the only permitted transitions from FOUNDER_DECISION
silence is NOT approval · absence of AUTHORISE is NOT authorisation
authorisation=false and execution=false on every orchestrator-emitted record · these are literal-false type fields
LIMITED_V0 stage markers MUST remain visible in the workstation and in the trace · MUST NOT be rendered as VERIFIED or PRODUCTION_READY
NOT_IMPLEMENTED markers MUST remain visible for EXECUTION · VERIFICATION · RELEASE · image generation · live preview · actual application generation · at v0.1.0
orchestrator MUST NOT bypass Evidence Validation · every specialist record passes through validateEvidence() before NEX2 consumes
external_llm_used=false · deterministic=true · same authorised request + same registered specialists → identical state transitions and identical decision structure across runs
Independence Constitution preserved · no cloud LLM · no network reasoning · no third-party inference service
